      5.4. The necessity of the Ap condition for singular integrals.

The Ap condition is necessary and sufficient for the Hardy-Littlewood
      maximal function to be bounded on LP (w ), 1 < p < 00, and to be weak
      (1,1) with respect to W, but we only showed th~t it is a sufficient condition

for Calder6n-Zygmund operators. The Ap condition is also necessary in the
      following sense: if w is a weight on JRn such that each of the Riesz transforms
      is weak (p,p) with respect to w, 1 < p < 00, then w E Ap. In particular,
      the Hilbert transform is weak (p, p) with respect to w if and only if w E Ap.

This is proved for the Hilbert transform in the article by Hunt, Muckenhoupt
      and Wheeden cited above, and their argument can be adapted to the case
      of Riesz transforms in JRn . Further, Stein [17, p. 210] has shown that if any
      of the Riesz transforms is bounded on LP(w), 1 < p < 00, then w E Ap.
